description: This file defines the RemoteActionMapping class, which is a plugin for handling remote control action mappings, including IR code and five-digit code management, within the WPEFramework. It includes enums for status and load states, method declarations for managing device keys, IR codes, and timeouts, as well as event handlers and internal utilities.

classes.name: RibLoadTimeoutImpl
